summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (d/b/a Hepsiburada, NASDAQ: HEPS), a Turkish e-commerce platform, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release, proxy card, agenda explanatory notes, 2025 board activity report and independent auditor report for its Ordinary General Assembly to be held October 30, 2026 in Istanbul. Agenda items cover approval of 2025 financials, dividend decision, director election and terms, auditor appointment for 2026, related-party authorizations, and an amendment to Article 11 on board meeting quorum. ADS holders vote through The Bank of New York Mellon. This is a routine annual meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for dividend and board-composition outcomes.
